scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1] / [LTIM.1.3.1]: `Duration - Duration` with the right operand the larger is `0_s`. One D, `x` 2 s and `y` 5 s. Rule `saturates` fires where `d.x - d.y == 0_s`; rule `negative`, where `d.x - d.y < 0_s`, would fire on the unsaturated -3 s and must not; rule `render` logs `(d.x - d.y)::String`, `0s`. A constant `BACK = 0_s - 3_d` is inlined where rule `back` reads it, and is `0_s` there too, so `back` fires. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `rlow_6_1_6_saturating` lowering `Duration - Duration` to `FN_MAX(x - y, 0)` ([RLOW.6.1.6]), in a join test, in an action, and in a constant's inlined right-hand side (`lgra_13_3_const`).
rules_ds:
const BACK = 0_s - 3_d

schema D scope logical:
    id: Int key
    x: Duration mutable
    y: Duration mutable

rule saturates:
    D d where d.x - d.y == 0_s
->
    log info "zero"

rule negative:
    D d where d.x - d.y < 0_s
->
    log info "negative"

rule render:
    D d
->
    let s = (d.x - d.y)::String
    log info "d {s}"

rule back:
    D d where d.id == 1 and BACK == 0_s
->
    log info "back"
